title: Images section (.bzXtMb) mis-centers on knowledge-panel pages; zoom change breaks centering
description:
Reported by user 2026-09-27 (Dev Edition FF156, add-on 1.0.5 unsigned build, wide window).

REPRO: search 'banana' -> knowledge-panel page with photos. The images section (.bzXtMb) does not center correctly. Changing browser zoom 'breaks' the centering (scope: unclear if all targets or this row only).

SUSPECTS (from content.js review): (a) zone rebalance shifts outer tracks of #rcnt while 1/-1 rows stay full-bleed — .bzXtMb content may inherit zone position in a way that reads off-center; (b) zoom fires resize -> caches: colWidth captured ONCE (never invalidated), base.iw tolerance 2px, verifyCount reset — a stale/partial recalculation mid-relayout could compound. Next: live probe (Xvfb + real Firefox + marionette) on banana en+pt at 2560, geometry of column/panel/.bzXtMb before/after, then zoom matrix 80/100/110/125/150.

title: AI controls: translate the FRAME, not an inner wrapper (hover fill + ask bar detach)
description:
User report 2026-11-09 (two screenshots): (a) hovering 'Show more' lights a rounded box shifted right of the pill border, as if the hover region were centered; (b) 'Ask anything' bar's '+' and placeholder float ~285px inside the bar, as if the input were centered.

Cause: firstPillAncestor() took the first ancestor merely WIDER than the seed — often the label's hover-fill wrapper, or the group holding the + button and the textarea. Translating that inner wrapper leaves the control's own frame behind.

Fix (1.0.13): controlFrame(seed, blockEl, minW, minH, maxH) climbs to the OUTERMOST ancestor that is still the control's own frame (stops at aiHeadingEl, the block, a control root, blockW*0.95 or maxH). Plus a guard: a control inside the container getAiInner already centered is not shifted again.

Evidence: live 1920x995 on google.com (manual FF + solved profile): before = translateX(224px) on div.niO4u/div.esoFne (inner); after = transform on div.in7vHe (652 = column width) for the pill and on the bar frame for the ask bar, zero transforms inside either frame. Regression tools/test_ai_frames.py (RED before, GREEN after); all other suites GREEN.
close_reason: Fixed in 1.0.13 (commit 302b72b, pushed). Regression tools/test_ai_frames.py: RED before (transform on .hoverwrap / .innergroup), GREEN after (transform on the frame, label/textarea keep native offset inside it). Live-verified on google.com 1920x995 with the solved profile: transform now on div.in7vHe (652 = column width) and on the ask-bar frame, zero transforms inside either frame; hover screenshot shows the fill flush inside the pill border. All other suites GREEN.
